EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Evidence Aware Errors

Evidence Aware Errors workflow for coding agents. Use when an error needs a factual report.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. State location and observation; name a cause only when evidence supports it.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: auth.spec.ts:42 expected 200, got 401.

At auth.spec.ts:42: expected 200, got 401. Inspect auth setup; cause unconfirmed.

Use the helper

error_report

Source: skills/evidence-aware-errors/SKILL.md in the package. Use this workflow selectively; it does not override user or system instructions.
